UNCLEAR||The question does not specify whether it refers to formal or informal register.

Question: Complétez : « Les enfants ___ leurs devoirs quand leur mère ___ à la maison. »

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] avaient fini / est rentrée
B. [WRONG] ont fini / est rentrée
C. [WRONG] avaient fini / était rentrée
D. [WRONG] finissaient / est rentrée

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect (letters: B, C, D)

responses.raw: FALSE|B|B uses the passé composé "ont fini" which doesn't indicate the action was completed before another past event. The question requires the plus-que-parfait "avaient fini" to show the homework was finished before the mother returned (plus-que-parfait + passé composé sequence).

TRUE||B uses passé composé instead of plus-que-parfait, failing to convey anteriority; C incorrectly uses plus-que-parfait after "quand" for the subsequent action; D changes the meaning by using imparfait for an ongoing action rather than a completed one.
